title: Signal: Gemfile loads a gemspec from a build-machine path
scope: A Gemfile file that declares a `gemspec` directive that points at a path rather than a gemspec name.
limitations: It matches a `gemspec` directive that points at a path rather than a gemspec name in the parsed Gemfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A Gemfile that mentions a `gemspec` directive that points at a path rather than a gemspec name in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
